hero.title: The Dedicated People Powering NIMO's Mission

principles.title: Do No Harm & Accountability
principles.description: Adhering strictly to IASC humanitarian guidelines and community feedback mechanisms in every intervention.

principles.title: Survivor-Centred & Safeguarding
principles.description: Prioritizing dignity, confidentiality, and informed consent with rigorous PSEA protocols.

principles.title: Community-Led Ownership
principles.description: Partnering with traditional rulers, women leaders, and youth champions rather than imposing outside solutions.

principles.title: Evidence-Driven Impact
principles.description: Grounding all field programs in rigorous baseline surveys, vulnerability mapping, and participatory M&E.

members.name: Dr. Sarah Mbella
members.bio: Over 14 years steering grassroots humanitarian action, institutional partnerships, and community-driven development across Central Africa.

members.name: Emmanuel Ngufor
members.bio: Directs NIMO's cross-sectoral interventions, ensuring compliance with international emergency standards, safety protocols, and field logistics.

members.name: Grace Eposi Enanga
members.bio: Oversees Child-Friendly Spaces (CFS), case management for separated and vulnerable minors, and community child protection committees.

members.name: David Tabi Ashu
members.bio: Coordinates accelerated learning initiatives, teacher psychosocial training, and scholastic support for out-of-school and displaced children.

members.name: Blandine Bih
members.bio: Leads survivor-centred clinical referral pathways, confidential case handling, and gender transformative community mobilization.

members.name: Patrick Ndip
members.bio: Designs quantitative and qualitative surveys, conducts community baseline vulnerability assessments, and measures longitudinal intervention impacts.

members.name: Miriam Lum
members.bio: Builds active community feedback mechanisms and ensures local ownership of child safety networks and safeguarding reporting lines.

members.name: Roland Eyong
members.bio: Directs vocational apprenticeships, financial literacy workshops, and income-generating cooperative projects for vulnerable youth and women.

members.name: Constance Ayuk
members.role: Women's Safe Spaces & Menstrual Health Focal Point
members.bio: Coordinates dignity kit distribution, safe spaces for teenage mothers, and sexual reproductive health education in rural communities.

fieldVoices.quote: When you establish a safe space in a conflict-affected area, you witness a child transition from constant hyper-vigilance to laughing, drawing, and dreaming again. That transformation is why we are on the ground every day.
fieldVoices.author: Grace Eposi Enanga

fieldVoices.quote: True prevention of gender-based violence starts with traditional leaders, men, and youth having honest, courageous dialogues. When community elders champion women's safety, generational protection takes root.
fieldVoices.author: Blandine Bih

fieldVoices.quote: Rigorous community-level research ensures that every kit distributed and every classroom renovated directly corresponds to what families identified as their most urgent priority.
fieldVoices.author: Patrick Ndip
